system.description:
You spit forth 4 motes of flame. Make 4 ranged ninjutsu attacks against a creature in range. A single creature can be targeted by this jutsu no more than twice per casting. On a hit, the target takes 1d6+1 Fire damage.

If you score at least two hits with this jutsu on the same target, they must make a Constitution saving throw gaining 1 rank of Burned.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of attacks you can make with this jutsu by +2. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, if this jutsu would deal damage to a creature with at least 2 ranks of Burned, if they fail their saving throw, you can choose to trigger the Burned conditions damage. If you do, they lose all ranks afterwards. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can target a single creature up to 3 times, instead of twice. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can target a single creature up to 4 times, instead of twice.
